Marine / Maritime NDT Report Format — IACS Class-Society Accepted Sequence (Saudi Arabia)

Atlantis NDT Reporting Software ships the globally accepted 4-document Marine NDT report bundle out of the box — the sequence every IACS class society (ABS, DNV, Lloyd's Register, Bureau Veritas, RINA, ClassNK, KR, CCS, IRS, PRS, RS) requires for survey acceptance under IACS Recommendation No. 20, IACS UR W11 + Z23, and IMO MSC.1/Circ.1409. Inspections done in Saudi Arabia for owners, shipyards, drydocks, FPSO operators, jack-up rigs, semisub MODUs, jacket platforms, subsea pipelines and offshore wind structures generate the bundle automatically per inspection — calibration records and Level II certificates pulled live from the equipment and personnel registers.

  1. Cover Page — vessel particulars + IMO number + flag + class society + class notation + owner / manager (ISM) + builder + yard hull no. + survey type (Annual / Intermediate / Special / Docking / Damage) + inspection location (yard / port / drydock in Saudi Arabia) + report reference no. + revision + issue date.
  2. Calibration Record — instrument make/model/serial (Olympus EPOCH 650, Sonatest, GE USM Go+) + transducer S/N + frequency + element size + angle + calibration reference block (IIW V1/V2, DSC, ASTM E164, ISO 2400-1) + gain / range / DAC or TCG curve / sound velocity / wedge correction + calibration date + operator + couplant/penetrant/particle batch + lot no. (ASTM E1417, ASTM E1444) + equipment calibration certificate ref + next-due date (ISO/IEC 17025 traceable).
  3. NDT Level II Certificate — inspector name + employee ID + photograph + certifying body (ASNT SNT-TC-1A / CP-189, ISO 9712, PCN, ACCP, CSWIP) + method + level (UT-2, RT-2, MT-2, PT-2, ET-2, VT-2, PAUT-2, TOFD-2) + sector (welds / castings / forgings / tubes / composites / marine) + date of certification + expiry + last annual eye test (Jaeger J1 + Ishihara) per ISO 9712 §7.4 + authorising Level III signature + Written Practice reference.
  4. NDT Report — procedure reference no. + technique (UT Pulse-Echo, PAUT, TOFD, RT, MT-Yoke, PT-Solvent) + scope (weld IDs, plate thicknesses, joint geometry, surface condition) + reference code (ASME Section V, ISO 17635 / 17636 / 17640, AWS D1.1, IACS Rec. 20, UR W11) + findings (defect type / position / size / orientation / indication amplitude % DAC) + acceptance criteria (ISO 5817 Level B/C/D, ASME B&PV App. 12, class society rules) + sketches + photographs + UT A/B/C-scans + RT film index + inspector signature + Atlantis NDT Level III review signature + date.

The software enforces the sequence at PDF generation — an inspector cannot finalise a report without valid calibration record and Level II certificate evidence attached, eliminating class-surveyor rejections that cost dry-dock delay days.
